content:
maria: Morning team — async standup. Quick notes below.

maria: Yesterday: landed microbatch refactor + kernel scheduling tweak; ran kv perf suite (seq=512) and most metrics looked good. Blocker: seeing a ~6% p95 regression on A100 for seq=1024 after the kernel change. Today: triage root cause, run targeted benches, loop in @sam for tracer output.

sam: Saw the spike on staging — grabbed a trace (trace-2026-03-17-15). Looks like slot handoff stalls in the new allocator. Will upload flamegraph in a bit.

ops-bot: CI: perf-suite/kv-bench finished — 3 failing cases (seq=1024 on a100). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf-suite/8076 (attach: perf-8076.log)

lee: I can repro on our 8xA100 dev rig. Which commit hash should I check out?

maria: roll: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> 9f7c2a1 (the kernel scheduling patch). If you can repro, try with the legacy allocator too.

priya: I ran a quick local run with seq=1024 and saw same p95 bump. Turning off async prefetch in kernel config brought p95 back down. Try toggling `kernel.prefetch=false`.

alex: quick CR ping: PR #4123 (microbatch refactor) has two small comments addressed; can someone do a final skim? I want to avoid reverting if we can patch.

sam: short experiment suggestion: disable the new slot-steal heuristic and re-run 200 iterations. Config flag: `--slot-steal=off`. If that fixes it, we can narrow the patch.

maria: thanks — running these permutations now (legacy allocator, prefetch=false, slot-steal=off). Posting numbers in this thread when done.

maria: command I'm running for reproducibility: ```./bench/run_kv.sh --model=llama-13b --seq=1024 --runs=500 --trace-id=trace-2026-03-17-15```

priya: also leaving a note: cache warmup params changed in the refactor (kv.warmup=15 -> 8). Might be interacting with scheduling for long sequences.

lee: oncall note: I'll pick this up in the 2pm window and try the legacy allocator. Ping me if you see a regression on other hardware.

dev-bot: Reminder: bench-runner v2.3 rolled at 14:10 UTC; new artifact tags under /artifacts/bench/v2.3/:thumbsup:

maria: plan if regressions persist: 1) block canary rollout, 2) revert scheduling tweak, 3) ship patch with conservative defaults. If someone can help with CI triage that'd speed things up.

sam: I'll attach the flamegraph and perf logs in ~20m.

alex: I can take final CR after we have a passing perf run.

maria: thanks all — will update by EOD. :coffee:
